description: This file defines the class InitializationWizardModel, a Java model object used during the initialization process of the OpenMRS platform. It contains various configuration properties, constants, and fields related to the setup wizard, such as database configuration, installation methods, user credentials, and task management for the setup wizard.

classes.name: InitializationWizardModel
classes.description: A model object used by the InitializationFilter to hold properties configured by the user during the setup wizard process in OpenMRS.
